en: Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square in front of 3–4 story historicist buildings with shops on the ground floor. A tall Marian or plague column with a statue stands on a stepped base surrounded by trees in the middle of the square. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand around, and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. A church with a tower and cross is in the background on the right. The architecture and signage suggest a Central European city.
